features.passwordPopup: none - #ansInput is type=text with autocomplete=off, never a password field
features.keyboard: native system keyboard only (text input + single-space IME buffer reset + plain-text mirror)
features.ready: single far-right close cross, no duplicate exit buttons
features.feedback: animated tick, streak breakdown and false-answer correction flow
features.visual: persistent credit pill at z-index 9999, see-through hero title, Settings mixer, responsive capsules and guide-credit-pill
features.guideStart: Start practising closes the guide, unlocks speech, opens Home and launches Eng.start({})
features.search: Lib.searchIndex caches tokens across Session 7, my words and mistakes
features.ambient: Hardware video wallpaper in Lite and Full; neon canvas sleeps when interactions finish
features.liveWallpaper: bunny-live-wallpaper.mp4 is the 100% default active video; it plays at full brightness behind the Home screen, every tab, the .layer Dictation Player, the "Are you ready?" sheet and the Results screen
features.githubVideos: CONFIG.repoMedia lists only ./assets/bunny-live-wallpaper.mp4; runtime discovery is cached for five minutes in sdp.gh_assets_v32 and legacy caches are deleted on boot
features.ambilight: Dual synchronized video layers plus #bgLivePhotoAmbilight for portrait photos; horizontal edge feathering removes the 9:16 box seam on 16:9 monitors
features.gallery: Real 16:9 .gal-thumb video/photo previews, one Apply button per card, Next Wallpaper in the studio header, no fake fallback cards
features.wallpaper: Hardware video wallpaper in Lite and Full; neon canvas sleeps when interactions finish
features.githubMedia: discoverGitHubMedia reads only the GitHub contents API for assets/ and normalises download_url, origin prefixes, /assets/, ?v= and #t= suffixes to ./assets/<file>
features.readability: #bgContrastScrim adaptive radial scrim, --bg-dim live slider (#sVideoDim) 0-75, 14% default, razor-sharp text shadows in dark and light themes
features.photoWallpaper: #bgLivePhoto + #bgLivePhotoAmbilight with 12s auto-cycle for photos and ended-driven cycling for videos
features.crystalGlass: v32: rgba(6, 10, 22, 0.28) glass with blur(4px) in Lite and Full, a light 14% vignette and crisp multi-layer text halos keep the video vivid through every card
features.playback: src attribute on #bgLiveVideo, muted autoplay, idempotent play guards, stale Service Worker removal and ?v=32 JSON cache busters guarantee playback
